Package hec.rss.model

Class DssOutputGroups

java.lang.Object
hec.rss.model.DssOutputGroups
public class DssOutputGroups extends Object
The Class DssOutputGroups. Class Keeps track of the DSS output groups used in the DssOutputPanel Lists the vids associated with each JTable column for a specific rss.model.Element Also used for looking up specific vids for rss.model.Elements
